Fill in one word in the small talk phrase.
Past Simple чи Present Perfect? Обери пр: Past Simple or Present Perfect? Choose the correct form.
Що ти робив у суботу?: What did you do on Saturday?
До речі, ти коли-небудь був у Португалії: By the way, have you ever been to Portugal?
Я ходив у похід з друзями: I went hiking with my friends
Ти колись пробував тайську їжу?: Have you ever tried Thai food?
Блок на 10-12 хв, якщо лишився час, або: A 10-12 minute block if there is time left, or a warm-up at the start of the next lesson. In the choice section, pay attention to time markers: last weekend, on Friday = Past Simple; ever, never, since = Present Perfect. «I have never tried sushi in my life»: life is still going on, so it is Present Perfect. The translation may have other correct versions (How was your Saturday? etc.), accept them manually. The game can be played for speed: the student reads the beginning, the teacher or a partner finishes it.

10-12 хв на кінець уроку або як повторен: 10-12 minutes at the end of the lesson or as revision in the next one. In the gap with perceive, see and view are accepted; with harmful, bad is accepted too. Prepositions: suffer from, worry about, cope with, take a toll on, reach out to, complain about. Typical mistakes: «suffer of», «worry for». The game can be done orally: the teacher reads the definition, the student says the word.
Homework plus: доповни фрази згоди й нез: Homework plus: complete the phrases for agreeing and disagreeing.
З’єднай питання офіціанта з відповіддю к: Match the waiter’s questions with the customer’s answers.
Можна меню, будь ласка?: Can I have the menu, please?
Я б хотів шматок торта: I’d like a slice of cake
10 хв, якщо лишився час, або повторення: 10 minutes if there is time left, or revision at the start of the next lesson. Remind students: in requests and offers (Could I have some…? Would you like some…?) we use some, in negatives and ordinary questions any. In the translation, «чек» = a receipt (the slip you get after paying), and «рахунок» = the bill. The American version to go is accepted. The match section can be acted out: the teacher is the waiter, the student is the customer.
Homework plus: choose the correct option.
Fill in rather, prefer, to or than.
Мені важко відключитися від роботи ввече: I find it hard to switch off in the evening
Я б краще не працював у вихідні: I’d rather not work at weekends
Я віддаю перевагу роботі вдома, а не в о: I prefer working from home to working in the office
Головна перевага в тому, що я не витрача: The main benefit is that I don’t waste time commuting
10-12 хв наприкінці уроку або на початку: 10-12 minutes at the end of the lesson or at the start of the next one. Key: I’d rather + infinitive without to, and than; I prefer A-ing to B-ing; I’d prefer + to + verb. In the first gap only rather works, because «I’d prefer not go» is wrong. The last translation has many correct versions (benefit/advantage, commuting/on the commute), accept others manually.
